description:
Leveraged ETF map: for each underlying (QQQ, SPY, IWM, semiconductors, gold
miners, crude oil, BTC, Treasuries, China, single stocks like NVDA or TSLA) the
most liquid leveraged LONG fund and leveraged SHORT (inverse) fund, picked by the
highest 20-session average daily dollar volume. Only funds of 1.5x or more.

Use for "what is the 3x short for semis", "is there a 2x long on NVDA", "best
inverse fund to hedge QQQ". Pass underlying to look one up: it matches the
underlying name, the stock ticker, or any fund ticker.

Each row: underlying, group, pick {symbol, leverage (signed: +3 long, -2
inverse), avgDollarVolumeUsd}, others (the other funds on that underlying, most
liquid first), watchOnly (the pick trades under watchOnlyBelowUsd a day, so
spreads are wide). Every payload carries a units block. Leveraged and inverse
funds reset daily and decay when held: an instrument list, not a trade call.

limit.description: Rows per side, most liquid first (default 25)

underlying.description: Optional: an underlying or fund to look up, e.g. 'QQQ', 'gold', 'NVDA', 'SOXL'

name: get_leveraged_etf_map
title: Get Leveraged ETF Map
